decision_cruda.rationale: LH-06 is down at TJ-C512-01 (radio and CMMS agree). Repair is likely done by 11:30, in place, with a high estimate of 12:00. The stope has only 144 t, which is about 33 oz. After repair LH-06 can load about 178 t by 17:00 (about 5 h at 35.6 t/h), so it clears the stope by itself. A loan would only bring the loading forward and add no ounces by 17:00. A loan would also take a loader off its own stope or off a heading: development costs 0.2 oz/h at DS-C538-01 and 4 oz/h at DS-E543-02, and the other lenders are all producing. No reserve can be activated because no stope is stopped. Keep everything as is.
